title: ʻOhana assistance program for building family units
summary: A council member said on April 21 they could ask the housing department whether one property can receive more than one grant under the rules. Grants in the ʻohana assistance program may reach $100,000 for each qualified Maui County resident. The department said on April 17 that 40% of the ADUs the program has funded have two bedrooms.
